steps.body: An add-to story starts with a group and puts more into it.
steps.narration: An add-to story starts with a group and puts more into it.

widget.prompt: A basket holds 4 apples. 3 more go in. Show the new total.

commonCounts.feedback: That is the number before anything was added. Three more went in.

widget.missFeedback: Fill one square at a time, counting as you go, until the frame shows the number you need.
widget.successFeedback: Seven filled — 4 apples and 3 more make 7.

predict.prompt: A basket holds 4 apples and someone puts in 3 more. What is missing from the story?
predict.reveal: The story tells you both the start (4) and what was added (3). The TOTAL is what must be worked out.
